entities.name: Dragan Vasiljković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dragan Vasiljković, nicknamed Captain Dragan is a convicted war criminal and former commander of a Serb paramilitary unit called the Kninjas during the Yugoslav Wars. In 2005, prosecutors in Croatia accused him of committing alleged war crimes during the wars. A warrant for his arrest was subsequently issued by Interpol.
